title: Commonwealth Engine Fixes (CEF): what it does, which game version, and using it with Addictol or Buffout 4
content:
Commonwealth Engine Fixes (CEF): what it does, which game version, and using it with Addictol or Buffout 4
Commonwealth Engine Fixes (CEF, Nexus Mods) is a set of F4SE plugins for Fallout 4 (needs F4SE and Address Library):
- FCStruct2.dll, FaceGen optimizer: retries a failed NPC face paint once and falls back to a plain face instead of a "rust face"; paints more face steps per frame; reuses face texture arrays (uses extra video memory, released automatically when free video memory drops below 1024 MB). Using pre-made FaceGen files for every NPC is OFF by default because generic settlers then go bald.
- FCShadow2.dll: spreads the sun-shadow culling of pre-culled (previs) areas over the game's helper threads, with the same shadows as the game's own code.
- CEFCrashLog.dll: crash logger; writes Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\CEF-Crash-<date>_<time>.log.
Game version: FCStruct2 and FCShadow2 patch only Fallout 4 1.11.240 (they check F4SE's runtime version and the exe's build stamp and size). On any other build they load and patch nothing.
In game: F6 switches FCStruct2 on/off, F7 FCShadow2 (iToggleKey in their .ini files in Data\F4SE\Plugins). Their logs are FCStruct2.log and FCShadow2.log in the F4SE log folder: "installed" means active; "unexpected bytes ... not installing" means another mod already changed that spot in the game code and CEF left it alone.
With other stability mods: the CEF crash logger steps aside only when Buffout4.dll is loaded. With Addictol's crash logger (AddictolCrashLogger.dll) both would be active; keep one by setting bEnable=0 in CEFCrashLog.ini.
The two diagnostic tools (Run CEF Diagnostics.bat, Run Mod Doctor.bat) need Python 3, only read your files and write a report into the F4SE log folder with your Windows user name hidden.
The source is public on GitHub for review only (not open source: no re-uploads or modified versions). The author states it was made with AI and tested on one PC.
Mossy's Crash Log Analyzer reads CEF crash logs.
tags: commonwealth engine fixes cef fcstruct2 fcshadow2 cefcrashlog facegen optimizer shadow culling crash logger addictol buffout 4 f6 f7 toggle 1.11.240 unexpected bytes not installing bald settlers
verified_by: CEF 1.0.5a source read on GitHub (TheRealMBKYoungest/Commonwealth-Engine-Fixes) 2026-11-05: README, LICENSE, cef_version.h version gate, the three plugin .cpp/.ini files (CheckCall byte check before patching, Buffout4.dll stand-down, ini defaults), tools (no network or program-launch code). Addictol crash logger DLL name seen in an Addictol install. Speed claims by the author not tested.
